sections.title: Power BI + AI/ML
sections.subtitle: Bring predictive insight into the reports your teams use

sections.heading: See what could happen next
sections.body:
Power BI + AI/ML brings machine learning outputs into business reporting. It combines familiar dashboards with predictions and risk scores so teams can consider likely outcomes alongside current performance.

Use the accelerator to make model results easier to explore in Power BI. Shape each view around a business question, with the context needed to interpret a forecast or score before acting on it.

sections.heading: Predictive insight in Power BI
sections.description: Three capabilities that connect model outputs with business reporting.

cards.title: AI/ML in Power BI
cards.description: Bring model outputs into Power BI reports so teams can explore predictions alongside their existing business measures.

cards.title: Predictive dashboards
cards.description: Show forecasts alongside current and historical performance to support planning and highlight changing patterns.

cards.title: Risk scoring visuals
cards.description: Present risk scores with relevant context so teams can compare cases, prioritise review and understand where to look closer.

sections.heading: Start with the decision, then the dashboard

items.description: Define the business question and the action a forecast or score should support. Identify the report users and their needs.
Review the data and model outputs. Agree how predictions will be checked and how their limitations will be communicated.
Build Power BI views around the agreed measures. Show predictions, risk scores and the context needed to interpret them.
Validate the views with business users. Review data refreshes and model behaviour as the reporting becomes part of daily work.
